subject.title: fix(subagent): recover terminal transcript before lost context

question: Should OpenClaw accept current-run private transcript terminal-turn recovery for stale subagent lost-context sweeps?
rationale: The patch changes lifecycle and parent-delivery semantics from failed to successful based on transcript state, and automation cannot safely choose that recovery boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Accept Private Transcript Recovery
options.body: Proceed after exact-head validation because the branch follows the maintainer-stated current-run private transcript and successful terminal-turn boundary.

options.title: Require Live Gateway Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live Agent Teams or Gateway proof if maintainers want evidence beyond the transcript-reader boundary before accepting the semantic change.

options.title: Keep Error-Only Fallback
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers decide stale lost-context recovery must never infer success from a private transcript terminal turn.

recommendation.title: Accept Private Transcript Recovery
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head validation because the branch follows the maintainer-stated current-run private transcript and successful terminal-turn boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the clearest prior maintainer-direction comment for the current-run private transcript/status boundary.
